divergences.old: Every figma command following a redirect to any host and resending X-Figma-Token with it (#73 item 1): fetch strips only Authorization on a cross-origin hop, not a custom header
divergences.toil: A redirect to another origin is refused with HTTP, naming both hosts, and nothing is sent to the new one; redirects within the configured baseUrl's origin are still followed
divergences.why: A server-supplied Location must not carry the user's personal access token to a host they didn't configure. A change a principle requires, so a port makes it before a live run (CLAUDE.md, Porting).
